items.q: One person I appreciate very much and she was a very good friend, she was 18.

ctx.x: man was not too good. One person I appreciate very much and she was a very good friend, she was 18. She watched over these kids. This man had taken 3 of us into a room and I never had a drink in my life except once when I was a little baby.
How did you get in contact with this man?
